currentKnownProblems.summary: Task-scoped context pack is about 8-10s on the mounted WSL repository.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Prefer bounded status/session paths; revisit performance only with an explicit trust/cache design.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Explicit live graph and context reads remain filesystem-sensitive.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Warm cache first and opt into broad live diagnostics deliberately.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Tool-host child process launch can return EPERM while direct commands pass.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Run the command directly, then record it through validation run --direct-result.

currentKnownProblems.summary: Release artifact git-status preflight can exceed its 10-second limit on the mounted WSL workspace.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Build release artifacts from a clean ext4 worktree so commit metadata and package contents remain aligned.

currentKnownProblems.summary: External dogfood found hadara --version/-v print help and exit 1 while hadara version works.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Add conventional version aliases or document the intentional behavior before v0.4.4.

currentKnownProblems.summary: External installed-package dogfood saw DIST_LOOKS_STALE from hadara version --json in an ordinary toy project.
currentKnownProblems.guidance: Scope stale-dist diagnostics to HADARA-dev/source checkout contexts so user projects do not see dev-build warnings.
